Orbitals – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play Orbitals exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6002aKm1O

Team up with a friend as Maki and Omura in this intergalactic adventure! The future of the settlement rests on both of your shoulders. 

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, you’ll need teamwork and clear communication to overcome danger and navigate uncharted areas. Will you be able to save their home together? 

With the goal to honor the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, the Orbitals universe is brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack! 

#Orbitals
